instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, accordions, and cards have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='buy-kit-button', data-testid='activate-qr-nav-button').
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance reveals, scroll progress indicators, hover elevation, and line-by-line kinetic hero text reveal.
Integrate `@studio-freight/lenis` or Lenis smooth scrolling if possible, or smooth scroll CSS behavior for hash links.
Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react icons throughout for tactical safety styling (ShieldAlert, QrCode, HeartPulse, PhoneCall, Award, CheckCircle2, Lock, Zap, ArrowRight, Star).
Never use generic centered layouts or plain white backgrounds. Strictly apply the Dark Tactical #0A0D14 theme with high-visibility #FF3B30 red accents.
Use Sonner (`toast` from `sonner`) for feedback when clicking 'Activate QR', 'Buy Now', or submitting forms.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic Vercel/Inter UI. Use high contrast, noise/grid backgrounds, subtle red glow borders, clear typography hierarchy with Outfit and JetBrains Mono.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.performance: Ensure crisp responsive image rendering using native standard image containers without layout shifts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_contrast: Main text must be bright #F8FAFC over dark slate containers for maximum readability.
